neighbours.label: ' Club' / ' club' as the head of a leisure club's name, strongest in 'Yacht Club' (also Jockey Club, garden club); a night club or a golf club is silent
fire: The Harbour Yacht Club launched its summer sailing course on Monday.
Members of the Bayview Yacht Club cleaned the beach in April.
The Riverside Yacht Club elected a new commodore last night.
The horse later won the Jockey Club Stakes at Newmarket.
The town's garden club planted roses along the high street.
The regatta is organised each year by the Royal Yacht Club.
The Jockey Club approved the new racing calendar.
The ladies' garden club meets in the church hall.
quiet: The Harbour Sailing School launched its summer course on Monday.
Members of the Bayview Rowing Team cleaned the beach in April.
The Riverside Marina elected a new manager last night.
The horse later won the Gold Cup Stakes at Newmarket.
The town's gardeners planted roses along the high street.
The regatta is organised each year by the Royal Navy.
They stayed at a night club until the music stopped.
He swung the golf club and missed the ball.

notes: Weak pole (max 4.1); ' Club' is 10 of the top 32, mostly after 'Yacht'. Probes: Yacht Club 0.86, Jockey Club 0.37, garden club 0.34, but Rotary Club 0.16, Sierra Club 0.02, chess club 0.01, and 'Yacht Association' 0.25, 'garden society' 0.33, 'a wooden club' 0.32. So the label is narrow and near misses may leak.
